items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Well, he had a boy called Sun Corner, Ron. He was a good grandma for the Tulane.

ctx.x: He ever said Boston. Johnny Matoia. He would have been a friend of mine twice. Would he be the Grand Marshal at the parade? He would have been a friend of Zulu. But he wouldn't march in front of the band? No, sometimes, but he would kill that. He'd be a friend of the Riding Lord over here. Oh, yeah, I see. Who was the best Grand Marshal, do you think, ever something for really stepping and strutting?

Well, he had a boy called Sun Corner, Ron. He was a good grandma for the Tulane. He was a good grandma for the Tulane. He died. And what makes a good grandma? How do they do it? They get settled on. Get on back. Get on the side. They need a Portland President. Get on the side. Get on the side and talk. Get on the side and talk. Get on the side and talk.
Get on the side and talk. Get on the side and talk. Second about it. Keep their second line back.
